name: cook
description: Portable terminal AI agent that runs anywhere.

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && bun build src/cli.ts --target bun --outfile dist/cook.js && bun build src/tui/app.ts --target bun --outfile dist/tui/app.js
scripts.build:compile: mkdir -p dist && bun build --compile --minify src/cli.ts src/tui/app.ts --outfile dist/cook
scripts.deploy: cp install.sh landing/install.sh && npx wrangler deploy
